s: Seder kos rebii ubo h' seipim: achar sheshshata kos shel birkat hammazon — tzarik limzog kos rebii ligmor alayv hahallel vehahaggada, umatchil mi"lo lanu" belo beraka ad sop hahallel. Veachar kak omer alayv birkat hashshir. Yesh meporshim dehaynu "yehaleluka", vechotem "baruk atta Hashem melek ku'". Veyesh omerim dehaynu "nishmat kol chay ku' yishtabbach ku'", vechotem "baruk atta Hashem ku' habbocher ku'". Uminhag haolam kishne happerushim, ukemo sheyyitbaer. Vetzarik lomar alayv gam ken hallel haggadol, dehaynu me"hodu laHashem ki tob" ad "al naharot babel", shehem k"v "ki leolam chasdo". Velo yomar "rannenu tzaddiqim". (Veyesh omerim dehaynu me"haleluyah halelu et shem Hashem" ad "al naharot babel". Veken nahagu akshav). Uminhag haolam bimdinot ellu lomar hallel haggadol beemtza birkat hashshir, dehaynu shemmiyyad achar gemar hallel omerim: "yehaleluka" ad "atta el", veeno chotem "baruk atta Hashem melek mehullal battishbachot", meachar sheatid lachtom achar "yishtabbach": "baruk atta Hashem el melek gadol (umehullal) battishbachot", velamma yachtom b' peamim beinyan echad? Veim shakach vechatam bi"yehaleluka" — lo yachtom "baruk atta Hashem" be"yishtabbach". Veachar kak omerim hallel haggadol, veachar kak "nishmat ku' yishtabbach ku'", vechotem: "baruk atta Hashem ku' habbocher ku'". Veyesh nohagin shello lomar "yehaleluka" miyyad leachar gemar hallel, ella omerim hallel haggadol miyyad leachar gemar hahallel, veachar kak "nishmat" ve"yishtabbach" ad "vead olam (atta el)", veeno chotem bachatimat "yishtabbach", ella omer: "yehaleluka" kullo ad sopo im hachatima shel "yehaleluka". Veim shakach vechatam be"yishtabbach" — yomar achar kak "yehaleluka" belo chatima:
En tzarik ligmor hallel bimqom hasseuda, ella yakol legomrah ap bebayit acher. Veap sheeno shoteh had' kosot bemaqom echad — en bekak kelum:

Yesh omerim shetztzarik lishtot hakkos miyyad leachar chatimat "yishtabbach" o "yehaleluka" shelleachar "yishtabbach" qodem amirat happiyyutim shennohagin lomar, shehare taqqanat chakamim hayeta ligmor hahallel ubirkat hashshir al kos d', veim ken en lehapsiq benehem bepiyyutim sheenan mittaqqana kelal. Abal en nohagin ken bimdinot ellu:

Nohagin lomar "shepok chamateka vego'" qodem shemmatchil "lo lanu". Upotechin haddelet, kede lizkor shehu "lel shimmurim" veen mityorin mishshum dabar. Ubizkut emuna zo yabo mashiach, veyishpok haqqadosh baruk hu et chamato al haggoyim:

Ubiqtzat meqomot nohagin shello linol hachadarim sheyyeshenim sham belel pesach, ki hu "lel shimmurim lekol bene yisrael ledorotam" lehotziam miggalut hazzeh, veim yabo eliyyahu — yimtza petach patuach venetze liqrato bimhera, veanu maaminim bazeh, veyesh beemuna zo sakar gadol. Ubimqomot shemmetzuyin gannabim — en lismok al hannes, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"g. Venohagin bimdinot ellu limzog kos echad yoter mehamsubbin, veqorin oto "kos shel eliyyahu hannabi":
